$comment: The parts of the workbench the guided tour points at (src/tour.ts; app.ts adds each step's action by id), in the tour's order. The same list is the legend of the labelled screenshot in the docs (docs/tools/workbench/, tool-docs.mjs): tools/screenshots.cjs --only map marks each part's first shown target (or `mark`, where the tour's cut-out is a whole pane) and writes the positions to docs/images/guide/workbench-map.json. text: plain words, keys in backticks, {key:<action id>} for a shortcut from keyactions.ts. page: the guide page (src/guide.json) that explains the part.

parts.title: Your handlers
parts.text: Each open handler has a tab. The + starts a new one or opens yours: a file, an example or a Hub handler.

parts.title: The code
parts.text: Write the handler here. Squiggles mark problems; hover a name for its docs. {key:suggest} suggests names, `Alt+Enter` fixes.

parts.title: Check
parts.text: What Nucleus would reject or get wrong, each with why and a fix. It checks as you type. `F8` jumps to the next problem.

parts.title: Try it
parts.text: Runs the handler once per player, as Nucleus would, and shows what each one gets.

parts.title: Docs
parts.text: Every option and function a handler can use, searchable. Insert into handler puts an example in your code.

parts.title: Lines
parts.text: Every name a handler can use, in a list beside the code. Click one to insert it. `Ctrl+B` opens and closes it.

parts.title: Files
parts.text: The files that go with the handler. Your game on this PC links the game's folder, so Check compares paths with the real files.

parts.title: Save
parts.text: Saves the handler for Nucleus: as a .zip, .js or .nc file, or straight into Nucleus Co-op's handlers folder. `Ctrl+S` saves.

parts.title: Settings and help
parts.text: Settings, Advanced mode, keyboard shortcuts and What's new. Take the tour is here too, to see this again.
